title: Honest Simultaneous Band Width with Shrinking Not-Yet-Treated Donor Pools under Staggered Adoption
banked_reason: D0.5 exhausted three revision rounds at achieved tier subfield below the field floor; the sound constant-factor honest-width frontier remains novel but theorem-level comparison and related-work coverage do not clear field.
gap_reasons: The note proves an exact finite-dimensional Gaussian decision frontier and an honest Bonferroni SOCP approximation, but only for deterministic weights in a bespoke bounded-mean experiment with known covariance.

The necessary-and-sufficient degeneracy-safe certificate concerns strict improvement of the Bonferroni surrogate Gamma, while strict improvement of the exact frontier W is established only under zero bias with Loewner or disjoint-diagonal structure and for one constructed witness.
References to scpi and augsynth::multisynth as consumers therefore exceed what is operationally transferred, even though the prose correctly disclaims coverage for those procedures.
proof_attempt_summary: The run derived the attainable joint-bias exact Gaussian width frontier, a finite-sample Bonferroni SOCP with a constant-factor spectral guarantee, correlated and disjoint-diagonal strictness criteria, a rational witness, and a degeneracy-safe strict-gap certificate. The mathematical bundle survived citation and real-algebraic-witness repairs, but the field claim collapsed because the model retains deterministic weights and known covariance rather than transferring uniform inference to a published staggered-SC estimator class. A future re-raise should add pretreatment covariance estimation under primitive published error conditions and prove that the robustified nested-support program preserves honesty and the frontier comparison.
tldr: Staggered adoption creates shrinking not-yet-treated donor sets. Conditional on the declared nonempty rational fixed design, this note maps every treated-unit--horizon error into one deduplicated Gaussian contrast vector and defines the jointly attainable bias set generated by the shared calendar-time coefficients and cellwise remainder bounds. The exact honest deterministic linear-band frontier is the attained minimum, over the relevant product of donor simplexes, of the worst shifted Gaussian-cube radius over that joint bias set. A fixed-Bonferroni bias-plus-standard-error SOCP remains finite-sample honest and within the stated dimension-uniform spectral factor of this exact frontier. A legal common-donor family with rational covariance factor proves that the square-root covariance-condition-number dependence is order-sharp for fixed Bonferroni calibration. Zero-bias Loewner and diagonal row-disjoint results give computable strict nested-width gains. Separately, an in-house affine facial-reduction alternative and relative-interior strong duality yield an exact finite primal--facial-dual certificate for strict SOCP improvement on degenerate faces, together with a terminating real-algebraic construction and verifier; no quantitative runtime bound is claimed. Ben-Michael, Feller, and Rothstein provide donor geometry only; \texttt{scpi} and \texttt{augsynth::multisynth} are implementation consumers, not estimators covered by these theorems.
gap: BenMichaelFellerRothstein2022 is the published anchor for horizon-varying donor eligibility and a common deepest support; the proposal does not claim that its two \(\Gamma\) programs evaluate or dominate that paper's partially pooled estimator. CattaneoFengPalombaTitiunik2025 supplies non-asymptotic simultaneous prediction intervals and conic implementations, but does not minimize honest joint width over horizon-specific donor simplexes. Scalar convex-class efficiency theory does not supply the Gaussian-rectangle lower bound or a degeneracy-safe comparison of two nested conic feasible sets.
fill: The project derives a deduplicated contrast representation, an exact support-function bias radius, a finite-sample honest SOCP band, and a dimension-uniform width comparison. It gives an interval-certified staggered witness and poses a representation-complete facial-reduction certificate with explicit conic feasibility, exact algebraic verification, and a separation-dependent bit bound.
